spec.description: Kubernetes object-state overview built for Grafana 13 tabs and kube-state-metrics, with a focused Kubernetes Service detail tab.

spec.title: Nodes
spec.description: Total nodes reported by kube-state-metrics.

spec.title: Ready nodes
spec.description: Percentage of selected-cluster nodes whose Ready condition is true.

spec.title: Active namespaces
spec.description: Namespaces currently in the Active phase.

spec.title: Pods
spec.description: Pods in the selected namespace scope.

spec.title: Deployments
spec.description: Deployments in the selected namespace scope.

spec.title: StatefulSets
spec.description: StatefulSets in the selected namespace scope.

spec.title: DaemonSets
spec.description: DaemonSets in the selected namespace scope.

spec.title: Services
spec.description: Kubernetes Services in the selected namespace scope.

spec.title: Pod readiness
spec.description: Ready pods as a percentage of all selected pods.

spec.title: Unavailable deployment replicas
spec.description: Desired deployment replicas minus available replicas, clamped at zero.

spec.title: Unready StatefulSet replicas
spec.description: Desired StatefulSet replicas minus ready replicas, clamped at zero.

spec.title: Unavailable DaemonSet pods
spec.description: Desired DaemonSet pods minus ready pods, clamped at zero.

spec.title: Pods by phase
spec.description: Current pod phases over the selected time range.

spec.title: Container restart activity
spec.description: Estimated container restarts by namespace over Grafana's automatic rate interval.

spec.title: Deployment readiness
spec.description: Availability percentage for every deployment. Zero-replica deployments are shown against a denominator of one.

spec.title: StatefulSet readiness
spec.description: Ready replica percentage for every StatefulSet.

spec.title: DaemonSet readiness
spec.description: Ready pod percentage for every DaemonSet.

spec.title: Pods needing attention
spec.description: Pods whose current phase is Pending, Failed, or Unknown.

spec.title: Failed job pods
spec.description: Sum of failed pods reported for Jobs.

spec.title: Unbound PVCs
spec.description: PersistentVolumeClaims whose active phase is not Bound.

spec.title: HPAs at maximum replicas
spec.description: HorizontalPodAutoscalers currently at or above their configured maximum.

spec.title: Unschedulable nodes
spec.description: Nodes with the Unschedulable spec flag set.

spec.title: Service age
spec.description: Age of the selected Kubernetes Service.

spec.title: Ready endpoint addresses
spec.description: Compatibility count from kube_endpoint_address. On KSM 2.18+ the Endpoints resource is optional/deprecated, so zero can also mean that the metric is not collected.

spec.title: Service type
spec.description: The active kube_service_spec_type series for the selected Service.

spec.title: Service identity and cluster address
spec.description: Stable kube_service_info labels: UID, ClusterIP, ExternalName, traffic policy, and configured load-balancer IP.

spec.title: External and load-balancer addresses
spec.description: Configured external IPs and observed load-balancer ingress addresses.

spec.title: Ingress routes to this Service
spec.description: Ingress paths whose backend service_name matches the selected Service.

spec.title: Endpoint address details (optional)
spec.description: Legacy/optional Endpoints view. Requires the Endpoints resource to be enabled in recent KSM versions.

spec.title: Service labels (allowlist-dependent)
spec.description: Kubernetes labels are present only when kube-state-metrics metric-labels allowlisting exposes them.

spec.name: service_name
spec.label: Service
spec.description: Kubernetes Service name from kube_service_info. This control appears only on the Service detail tab.

spec.title: Kubernetes / KSM Cluster & Service Overview

spec.name: k8s_cluster_name
spec.label: Cluster
spec.description: Primary cluster selector. Requires the k8s_cluster_name label on KSM series.

spec.name: namespace
spec.label: Namespace
spec.description: Namespace scope shared by both tabs.
